My Dad is at the Usher and Chris Brown concert right now, and he’s texting me the timeline 😂

Ada, but I decided not to attend because, to me, it felt less like a concert and more like a religious ritual.

Just because I support the artist doesn’t mean I have to agree with or participate in everything associated with their performance. Supporting an artist should never mean compromising my own religious beliefs.

At the end of the day, my faith comes first. I choose my religion over any artist, performance or personal admiration.
